title: ICU Nurse

description:
John William Kiggundu (JWK) International Hospital Kakiri is a modern, private healthcare institution established to provide affordable, highly accessible, and premier quality healthcare services to the people of Uganda and the broader East African region.

Founded by Dr. Henry K. Lukwago, the hospital opened in October 2023 as an initial 50-bed modern facility. Our 24/7 Advanced Life Support ICU provides continuous, high-precision monitoring and life-saving medical interventions for critically ill patients around the clock.

**Position: ICU Nurse (2 Positions)**

**Responsibilities:**
- Monitor critically ill patients in the Intensive Care Unit
- Operate and maintain life support and monitoring equipment
- Provide continuous high-precision patient care under the direction of intensivists
- Administer critical care medications and IV therapies
- Respond rapidly to patient emergencies and code situations
- Maintain accurate ICU patient documentation and records
- Collaborate with the multidisciplinary critical care team

**Requirements:**
- Diploma or Certificate in Nursing from a recognized institution
- Specialized training or certification in Critical Care/ICU nursing
- Valid registration and license from Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council
- Experience in ICU or critical care setting preferred
- Strong clinical assessment and emergency response skills
- Ability to work under pressure in a high-acuity environment
- Excellent teamwork and communication abilities

**How to Apply:**

**Physical Delivery:** Hospital Admin Office, Kakiri - Opposite Police Barracks
**Email:** jwkhospital@gmail.com
**Contact:** +256 200 992 222

**Deadline:** 5th September 2026

John William Kiggundu International Hospital Kakiri - Delivering quality healthcare with compassion.
